subject: OrchidAI POC — acceptance criteria, owners & proposed weekly rhythm
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Lowe <hannah@orchidai.com>, Sam Patel <sam@orchidai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: OrchidAI POC — recap, acceptance criteria & proposed kickoff week

Hi Hannah / Sam — great to meet you on the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps to make the trial productive. TL;DR: suggested kickoff the week of Apr 18, 2–3 week focused trial, weekly 30m check-ins, and clear success metrics below.

Call recap / goals:
- Objective: validate Redwood inference for OrchidAI's real-time summarization pipeline (50–200 token outputs, peak qps ~12)
- Key constraint: response latency under 250 ms p50 for 128-token requests; stable throughput for bursts to 12 qps

Proposed success criteria (what we will measure at readout):
1) Latency SLO: p50 < 250 ms and p95 < 600 ms over a 24h window during peak tests
2) Quality: Rouge-L and human score (internal sample of 200 docs) meets baseline agreed threshold (we’ll align sample & rubric)
3) Cost proxy: average cost per 1k tokens during trial stays within expected budget band (TBD)
4) Reliability: <1% error rate and automatic fallback engaged correctly when capacity limits hit

POC scope & evaluation plan:
- 2–3 week hands-on trial: one sandbox dataset you provide + a synthetic traffic profile we’ll run to simulate peaks
- Deliverables: weekly readout + final performance report (latency/cost/quality) + configuration recommendations
- Owners: Soojin (commercial), Marissa (onboarding & acceptance), Rishi (technical configuration & perf tuning)

Timeline / cadence (proposed):
- Week of Apr 18 — kickoff (30–45m): environment access, data ingestion checklist, success metric sign-off
- Weeks Apr 18–May 2 — execution: implementation, daily light ops, weekly 30m check-ins (Tues 10:00 PT)
- Final readout — within 3 business days after trial end (performance report + recommended next steps)

Immediate next steps (from our side):
- I’ll share a draft timeline + mutual action plan (attached) for your review
- If the timeline works, I’ll send a short SOW via DocuSign for signature to get access provisioned

Attachments: OrchidAI_POC_timeline_v1.xlsx (timeline + owners), OrchidAI_MAP_v1.docx (mutual action plan)

If that looks good, please confirm: 1) target kickoff week (Apr 11 vs Apr 18), 2) any mandatory compliance docs we should prep (SOC2, IP/NDAs), and 3) who on your side owns data provisioning.

Thanks again — excited to get this moving.

—
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Hannah Lowe <hannah@orchidai.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrchidAI POC — recap, acceptance criteria & proposed kickoff week

Thanks, Soojin — really helpful recap. We’re aligned on the objective and most criteria. A couple of clarifications from our side:

1) Duration: our engineering lead prefers a focused 2-week pilot (we want to iterate fast) — would you be able to compress the runway if we prioritize peak latency tests + quality sample?
2) Data access: we’ll provision a sandbox S3 bucket and share temporary creds; Ben will be the owner for data transfer.
3) Compliance: we need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a CIAM questionnaire filled before production access; please send to legal@orchidai.com.

We are tentatively available for kickoff Apr 18. Also, can you confirm who will run the load profile and whether Redwood will simulate burst traffic or we should provide traffic replay?

Happy to confirm once we review the attached timeline — I’ll take a look this afternoon.

Best,
Hannah
VP Product — OrchidAI

1) Duration: We can compress to a 2-week focused pilot if we scope the minimum acceptance checks: (a) peak latency profile, (b) 200-sample quality eval, (c) failover verification. That reduces integration work and gets a decision faster.
2) Load profile: Redwood will generate the synthetic burst/replay if you can share a representative 1–2 hour traffic trace; otherwise we’ll run our standard burst profile. Please send the trace to marissa.cole@redwood.com.
3) Compliance docs: attaching the SOC2 summary and a filled CIAM starter for your legal team. If legal needs more, loop us and we’ll escalate.

Updated timeline (attached spreadsheet v1):
- Apr 18 (Mon) — kickoff (30m): confirm sample set, grant access to sandbox, hand off trace (if available)
- Apr 19–Apr 30 — execution window (10 business days) with Tuesday 10:00 PT weekly check-ins (first check-in Apr 20)
- May 3 — final readout (performance report + recommendations)

Action items assigned:
- Soojin: commercial coordination & DocuSign SOW
- Marissa: onboarding steps, runbook, and accepting dataset
- Rishi: tuning, quantization recommendation, and perf report

Attachments included in this message: OrchidAI_POC_timeline_v1.xlsx, OrchidAI_MAP_v1.docx, Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf, CIAM_starter_form.csv

Next: I’ll send the DocuSign SOW today so procurement can start. If the kickoff week works for you, reply-all with a quick approval and Ben can share the dataset creds.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
Soojin
